name: Reed.co.uk Jobs API
tagline: Free public UK job search API from Reed's major job board.
description: Reed.co.uk provides a free public REST API for searching UK job listings, retrieving job details, and accessing employer/recruiter data. Developers can query by keywords, location, salary, and other filters using HTTP Basic authentication with an API key. Ideal for job aggregators, career tools, and UK employment market analysis.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth (key as username, empty password). Self-serve signup at developers page.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API key with no published request quota on the developers page

use_cases: search UK job listings by keyword and location
get details for a specific job posting by ID
filter jobs by salary range and permanent/contract type
build a UK job aggregator or career board integration
analyze hiring trends from public Reed job data
